title: Mac Monitor telemetry 1.0.0
description: The records Mac Monitor writes: its JSONL and pretty exports, and the macmonitor command line's output. Each record is eslogger's JSON for an Endpoint Security event plus Mac Monitor's additions; every key is marked x-mac-monitor-origin: eslogger or mac-monitor, and everything under a Mac Monitor key is Mac Monitor's. Each GitHub release attaches the schema as Mac-Monitor.telemetry.schema.json, and the latest is at https://github.com/Brandon7CC/mac-monitor/releases/latest/download/Mac-Monitor.telemetry.schema.json.

context.description: A summary of the event, as Mac Monitor's event list shows it.
